items.t: Head gasket failure and overheating (Northstar head bolts)
items.job: Replace head gaskets and install head bolt thread inserts
items.note: RepairPal puts cylinder head replacement on the Eldorado at about $4,100-$5,200. The engine usually has to come out, so many owners compare the cost with the car's value.

items.t: Engine burns oil
items.job: Oil consumption test and piston ring cleaning service
items.note: If cleaning does not help, the fix is internal engine work that can cost thousands.

items.t: Oil leaks from the lower crankcase and oil pan seal
items.job: Reseal oil pan and lower crankcase
items.note: RepairPal lists Eldorado oil pan replacement at about $1,000-$1,200. Resealing the full lower crankcase takes more time.

items.t: Coolant leaks from the water pump or thermostat housing
items.job: Replace water pump and reseal thermostat housing
items.note: Labor depends on which seal is leaking.

items.t: No-start from the PASS-Key anti-theft system
items.job: Diagnose PASS-Key system and repair ignition cylinder wiring or key
items.note: A new resistor key is cheap; wiring in the column or a new module costs more.

items.t: Instrument cluster short can cause no-start (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace instrument cluster
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Fuel rail tubing can crack and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel rail with stainless steel rail and revised return line
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: ABS can cycle during normal braking (recall)
items.job: Replace electronic brake control module
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Evaporative purge wiring routed wrong (recall)
items.job: Reroute and secure evap purge harness
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Inner tie rod nuts can loosen (recall)
items.job: Tighten inner tie rod nuts and set toe
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Stalls or won't start from a failing crankshaft sensor
items.job: Replace crankshaft position sensor

items.t: Stumble or stall when coming to a stop
items.job: Diagnose stall, clean throttle body and update engine computer

items.t: Check engine light with chuggle or surge (torque converter clutch)
items.job: Replace torque converter clutch solenoid or control valve
items.note: A torque converter or transmission rebuild costs far more if the clutch is worn out.

items.t: Speedometer drops out and cruise control quits
items.job: Replace vehicle speed sensor or repair wiring

items.t: Delayed or harsh shift into reverse or drive
items.job: Transmission fluid and filter service with diagnosis

items.t: ABS or traction light on or unwanted ABS activation
items.job: Diagnose ABS and replace wheel speed sensor
items.note: A brake control module costs more.

items.t: Rusted or burst brake lines
items.job: Replace rusted brake lines and bleed brakes
items.note: RepairPal lists Eldorado brake hose replacement at about $150-$200; full steel line runs take longer.

items.t: Brake pulsation and fast rotor wear
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Service StabiliTrak or check stability system message
items.job: Diagnose stability system and replace steering angle or wheel speed sensor

items.t: Power steering shudder or moan when parking
items.job: Power steering fluid flush and hose inspection

items.t: Front-end clunk or rattle over bumps
items.job: Replace front stabilizer links or bushings

items.t: Trunk lid will not close or latch
items.job: Replace trunk pull-down switch or actuator

items.t: Rear quarter trim panel sags or warps
items.job: Install GM trim panel repair kit

items.t: Heated front seat stops warming
items.job: Replace seat heating element or switch

items.t: Check engine light for a small evaporative leak
items.job: Evap smoke test and replace gas cap or filler neck seal

items.t: Fuel gauge swings when the tank is full
items.job: Replace fuel level sending unit

items.t: Power door locks stop working
items.job: Replace door lock actuator
